name: active
meaning: 1 while the dialogue is open; Dialog_Close zeroes it

name: inputLatch
meaning: debounce flag cleared every frame Dialog_Update runs without a confirm

name: sender
meaning: the NPC that opened the box; receives nothing but is echoed back to the Wolf as the 0x0E/0x0F sender

name: selected
meaning: answer row latched on CROSS, copied from the draw box's cursorRow

name: replyText
meaning: reply strings from Text_GetClassString(base+2+2i), replayed by Dialog_UpdateAnswer

name: listA
meaning: the choice list's nodes built by Menu_BuildList 0x539199 (n + 2 for up to three answers; the box's drawBox.pages)

name: listB
meaning: the Menu over listA built by the same call (the box's drawBox.list)

name: drawBox
meaning: the MenuBox handed to Ui_DrawMenuBox; its text is questionText and its list pointer is &listB
